meta-ads-9x16.description: Paid 9:16 placements (Reels, Stories, Facebook Reels): Meta's text-free margins only. The organic caption band sits inside Meta's bottom 35%, and Meta specifies no eye line, so both are absent here. The Remotion ContentEngineReel composition draws the organic layout and does not pass this profile.
meta-ads-9x16.source: Meta Ads Guide, Instagram Reels: leave at least 14% of the top, 35% of the bottom and 6% of each side free of text (fetched 2026-09-29). legibility is carried over from reels-organic.
